exposure: Timing of Cesarean delivery (second stage vs. other stages)
cohort: 3222 women who delivered at John Radcliffe Hospital in Oxford, UK in 1976, 1986, 1996, or 2006
finding: The proportion of deliveries by Cesarean section in the second stage of labor increased over a 30-year period and was associated with greater maternal and neonatal morbidity.
mod_finding: The proportion of cesarean deliveries during the second stage because of failed instrumental delivery increased from 59.1% in 1976 to 71.0% in 2006.
